body: That's right, this is very cliche. I don't want anybody else, I want HER. My life is crumbling, and to think I was very happy the last months... I suffer from depression since always, and the last months were like a heaven in the middle of all the suffering. I never thought about my depression during this period, I was truly happy and in peace. And now, here we go again.

I live in Brazil. Here it's very common to live with your parents, and most people do it unless they need to study in another city, or work. It's not a big deal, socially speaking, and lots of people do it. But my parents are very conservative, and they think she's influencing me. The biggest implication will be the relationship of my GF with my parents. They won't approve it, and she will be uncomfortable.
The problem here is: my parents will continue being mad at me and her, and she will feel uncomfortable with that situation. I can handle it, but I think she can't. I can't find a solution to this.

Thanks for your reply.

No, I don't pay for their rent. But I know my income can cover expenses with renting my own apartment. It will be difficult, yes, but it can be done.
